thread:
Aisha (CS): Quick heads-up - Northpeak renewal: procurement sent PO with delegated signer that doesn't match authorized signer list. We tried DocuSign, envelope failed. CTO/CFO need to sign, but signer on PO is 'Northpeak Ops' not an approved approver. @Tom (Legal) @Priya (CS) any fast options?

 docusign-bot: Envelope 0a3f5 failed to send - status: error; reason: signer_email mismatch with recipient list. See: https://docusign.example/0a3f5 (auto)

 Tom (Legal): Ugh. Two quick paths: 1) customer uploads a signed PO PDF (wet signature) and we attach it to the amendment, or 2) customer updates delegated signer via their procurement portal and we resend DocuSign. Legal prefers electronic audit trail but accepts wet sign if timing is tight.

 Priya (CS): We're on a call with Northpeak procurement at 09:30 PT tomorrow. I'll ask them to confirm the authorized signers and get an updated PO. If they can email a PDF right now I can attach it and get internal ops to proceed.

 Dan (Finance): Also need vendor_code (we currently have "NK-0001") and payment terms confirmed. Can we accept Net30 on this renewal? Northpeak is asking Net45 but billing ops flagged higher risk.

 Aisha (CS): Net30 is our standard for renewals at this tier - I'll push back on Net45 on the call. If they insist, we need credit ops approval which will delay signing.

 Priya (CS): For speed, I'll ask them to sign the PO PDF and email to procurement@redwood.com during the call. If they agree, I'll upload and ping @docusign-bot to create an envelope for signature of the amendment only.

 Tom (Legal): If they email a scanned PO, ask them to include a one-line confirmation: "I confirm the signatory below is authorized to execute this PO on behalf of Northpeak." That keeps the risk low.

 Dan (Finance): OK - once we have the signed PO PDF + confirmed vendor_code and Net30, I can approve invoicing. FYI: sample PO header we need:

 ```
 PO#: NP-2026-089
 Vendor: Redwood Inference
 Vendor Code: NK-0001
 Amount: $120,000
 Terms: Net30
 ```

 Aisha (CS): Thanks team. Action items: Priya to get updated PO/signer confirmation on call tomorrow; Dan to standby for invoice approval; Tom to confirm amendment language if they send wet-signed PO. I'll update renewal plan doc aftercall. :thumbsup:

 Priya (CS): Will do - will post the PO PDF in this thread and @Dan when I have it.

 Aisha (CS): Perfect - resolving for now, re-open if the call says otherwise.
